inbound_fields.meaning: selector for unique current server-held evidence
selector for one enabled complete server-owned route binding

invariants.rule: One authorize call captures one decision time and performs every trusted-input and authorization-state read plus kernel evaluation through one SQLite connection and one query-only transaction that is rolled back after the decision.
Opaque lifetime-bound values derive from the transaction capability; the numeric epoch identifier is unique only within the live service instance, never wraps, and is not authority.
The authenticated subject and session copied from the unique evidence row equal the unique authorization-state session subject and identity.
Evidence and route revisions are preserved but never numerically equated with the authorization-state revision.
Any input, clock, identifier allocation, transaction, query-only, query, cardinality, field, revision, boundary, kernel, or rollback uncertainty returns DENY.
Normal startup validates an already-migrated unified schema; an explicit separate migration operation owns schema creation and v1-to-v2 upgrade.

claim_limit: Agent-facing business-ontology prototype; no ontology admission, product approval, or operational authority.
